description.value: Cockney Kings Fish & Chips is a family-owned institution that has been serving classic English-style fish and chips since 1965, growing from a single East Hastings shop into four Metro Vancouver locations. The Burnaby location on Hastings Street is a full-service dine-in restaurant offering a wide range of fresh fish options including cod, haddock, salmon and halibut, all fried in traditional beef tallow. With over 60 years of community history and a loyal multigenerational following, it's a well-established stop for a substantial, no-frills meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Burnaby location of a multi-branch chain at 6574 Hastings Street, Burnaby, BC V5B 1S2 — the OSM community field incorrectly says 'North Vancouver'. Phone 604-291-1323 and website URL both match OSM. Washrooms confirmed via OSM tags (toilets=yes, toilets:wheelchair=yes) on a verified full-service dine-in restaurant; takeout confirmed by OSM takeaway=yes and explicit website ordering pages; vegetarian/GF options confirmed via the FAQ page with specific detail about beef tallow and gluten-friendly items. No evidence on the website or in OSM for bike parking, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the address (6574 Hastings Street) and website both confirm this is the Burnaby location, not North Vancouver.
OSM email is info@cockneykings.ca but the website lists the Burnaby-specific contact email as bby@cockneykings.ca.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, long-established dine-in and takeout restaurant with confirmed washrooms and a substantial menu; a useful food and rest stop for touring cyclists on Hastings Street in Burnaby.
enrichment_extras.notes: Multi-location chain; three other locations in New Westminster, Kitsilano, and Main Street Vancouver. The OSM node represents the Burnaby branch only.

Washrooms.detail: Full-service dine-in restaurant with wheelchair-accessible toilet confirmed in OSM. Website does not mention washrooms explicitly

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website FAQ confirms vegetarian options (salads, certain sides), several gluten-friendly items (grilled/steamed fish, garden salad, coleslaw, corn tortilla fish tacos), and notes chips are technically gluten-free but share fryers with wheat products. Deep-fried items including chips cooked in beef tallow, making vegan options very limited

wow_evidence: family-owned institution that has been serving classic English-style fish and chips since 1965, growing from a single East Hastings shop into four Metro Vancouver locations
